merchant: Welcome, adventurer! Browse my fine selection of wares and materials.
The trade routes have been dangerous lately, but my inventory remains unmatched.
Bring me rare materials, and I'll make sure you get a fair price in gold.
blacksmith: Looking for sturdy steel or a sharp edge? You came to the right forge.
Good metal isn't cheap, but it will save your life out in the wilderness.
Keep your gear repaired. A dull blade is a dangerous thing in Sunder.
apothecary: Potions, catalysts, and alchemical remedies... what ails you?
Harvesting wild plants and monster shards yields potent concoctions.
A single health potion can be the difference between victory and defeat.
tavern_master: Pull up a bench! Have a cold mug of frothy beer or warm hearth bread.
Travelers pass through here daily. Ask around if you're looking for rumors.
Nothing cures overworld fatigue quite like a good meal and a rest.
guard: Keep your weapon sheathed in settlement bounds, traveler.
Watchtowers keep Sunder safe from outlaw raids. Support your local faction.
Report any suspicious activity or wild beast sightings directly to us.

quests.title: Clear the Wild Wolves
quests.description: Defeat 3 wild wolves terrorizing the settlement borders.

quests.title: Supply Oakhaven Timber
quests.description: Collect 5 Oakhaven Timber logs for the blacksmith forge.

quests.title: Claim a Watchtower
quests.description: Reach and secure a regional watchtower for your faction.
